title: Red Dead Redemption 2
summary: Unofficial DX12 port adding configurable HDR tone mapping and color grading to Red Dead Redemption 2's DirectX 12 renderer. Work in progress.
notes: Requires the DirectX 12 graphics API and HDR enabled in game.
Work in progress: the HDR output pass is replaced, the tone-map passes are not. Untested in game.
Shader hashes are DX12-specific and unrelated to the Vulkan mod's.
